shots.detail_en: CH stands at the rooftop edge at dawn, an iron wind vane spinning in the wind beside him as he presses the slow-by-one-minute pocket watch to his chest.
shots.sub: 熊天成说过——散沙聚得越快，风越好借。现在，风真的来了。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: XIONG sits composed and solemn in a TV interview glowing inside the cha chaan teng.
shots.sub: 我看空的每一只票，最后都跌了。我，从来没有做错过任何事。
shots.speaker: 熊天成（电视）

shots.detail_en: 散户甲 slams the table and rises while MANCANG still has half a pineapple bun in his mouth.
shots.sub: 熊爷发话了！联华实业要完了！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG chokes on the bun, his eyes darting left and right in panic.
shots.sub: 熊爷？！可我们不就在……里头吗？
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: The opening bell rings and the old trading hall floods with a surging crowd pouring toward the giant red-and-green flip-board.
CH leans by a pillar staring up at the board, his gaze sinking.
shots.sub: 影线比实体还长——有人把风画进了盘口。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG lowers his telescope on the second-floor VIP gallery, thumbing his prayer beads with a warm smile.
shots.sub: 风不是我造的。我只是提前开了窗。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Three flash cuts of the rumor mutating — cha chaan teng, street fish stall, exchange steps — each retelling wilder than the last.
MANCANG throws his arms wide, blocking a crowd that splits in half as a stream of sellers surges toward the counter.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: 散户乙 shoves MANCANG aside and strides away without looking back.
shots.sub: 熊爷都看空了，你算老几？
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: A first thick stack of sell order slips slams onto the counter, paper piling into a small mountain.
Thousands of paper order slips explode upward in slow motion, filling the air like a blizzard — the market tsunami spectacle.
shots.sub: 那一天，我看见了风的形状。
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: The giant flip-board turns green wave after wave, a green tide rolling left to right across the entire screen.
shots.speaker: 散户群（画外）

shots.detail_en: MANCANG is swept along by the crowd, lifted off his feet, his face pressed flat against the board glass.
shots.sub: 我全仓啊——啊不，我兄弟们全仓啊！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: 散户甲 and the brothers crowd around MANCANG in the opposite camp, blaming him at point-blank range.
shots.sub: 都怪你！满仓满仓——满的是熊家的仓！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: MANCANG holds tears in his eyes while the corners of his mouth still try to smile.
shots.sub: 可我一颗没卖……我满仓我骄傲啊……
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH stands perfectly still against the flowing crowd, the only motionless figure in the rushing river of people.
CH's pocket watch ticks one minute slow, the crisp tick cutting through the roar.
shots.sub: 风大的时候，别顶风。等它转弯。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: XIONG overlooks the hall from above at closing, his smile thick and warm over the deep green candle.
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: RED counts the order slips behind the counter, her finger stopping on one stack as her brow furrows.
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: The red and green giant waves on the 联华实业 board collide and freeze into a tsunami line, a wind vane silhouette rising in the corner of the frame.
shots.speaker: 旁白（长虹）

shots.detail_en: Black card with the next-episode teaser.
